sentences.span: Yields have broken out, MOVE has exploded higher, and the SPX has yet to react much... Beyond that, the next major level is 5.5%
sentences.why: TME desk note frames the yield breakout as having room to run (next level 5.5%, beyond the 5.11% already hit) while equities have 'yet to react much' — matches 'repricing has further to run' and 'equities have not finished discounting it.'

sentences.span: input cost inflation being the largest monthly increase since 2020 (now around its highest level since late 2022)
sentences.why: JPMorgan figure matches verbatim. The 'resume tightening after a pause' framing is corroborated by source-text-all/2026-09-23/17269 ('the Federal Reserve raised rates by 25bp for the first time in three years') and 17551 ('the Fed's first rate hike in over three years').

sentences.span: hear from the Fed's Williams, Barkin, Hammack and Paulson
sentences.why: Sources only list Williams and Paulson as scheduled Thursday speakers (Reid: unspecified time; GS Armbrust: Paulson at 10:10am). No source in the set reports what either official actually said, so the claim that they said anything 'out loud' confirming the repricing has no content to verify.

sentences.span: yields are moving towards fair value (5.5%), similar episodes have historically been buying opportunities, equity valuations offer a cushion
sentences.why: Directly matches JPM's fair-value estimate and the buying-opportunity framing for equities.

sentences.span: taking it up to a post-2007 high of 5.11%... A weak 5yr auction also didn't help matters... after $70bn of notes were sold at 5.03%, +3.1bps above the pre-sale yield
sentences.why: 5.11% is the 10-year cash yield reached that day, not the five-year auction's clearing yield — the 5yr notes actually sold at 5.03% (JPM's afternoon briefing separately reports a 3.20bp auction tail). The sentence uses the 10yr figure as the test level for whether real-money buyers took down 'the five-year paper,' conflating two different instruments' yields.
PCE (a combined income/spending and price release) due Sept 30 is confirmed; JPM's 5.5% fair-value level is confirmed elsewhere (s4) as the anchor for the overshoot debate.

sentences.span: We initiated the lower-vol Earnings Vulnerability JPUXERNV Index basket as a hedge versus Semis/AI SMH Equity
sentences.why: Checkable component ('just bought' insurance = a newly initiated hedge) is confirmed; the comparative framing ('more informative half') is editorial analysis built on that confirmed fact, not an assertion of a source's own stance.

sentences.span: We maintain our core view of +Tech vs. -RTY and that Tech view is a mix of Mag7, Memory, and Semis
sentences.why: Matches 'more technology than benchmark across mega-caps, memory and semiconductors' and the short-small-cap leg (RTY = Russell 2000, tracked by $IWM, a standard ticker/index equivalence).

sentences.span: we think Put option on Earnings Vulnerability JPUXERNV Index basket offer a cheaper way to hedge Semis/AI risk into month-end rebalancing
sentences.why: The traded put-option hedge is on the 'Earnings Vulnerability' (JPUXERNV) basket, described only as a lower-vol, ~70%-beta-to-Semis hedge versus SMH — not defined as an AI-agent-disruption basket. The 'companies whose earnings are most exposed to AI agents taking their business' description actually belongs to a different, separately named basket (JPUXCAIV, the Muse/consumer-agent disintermediation basket flagged by TMT's Heavey). The sentence attributes JPUXCAIV's description to the JPUXERNV trade.

sentences.span: SHOP (-7%) is getting whacked today... EXPE Equity and CART US Equity getting hit despite partnerships announcements
sentences.why: Transition sentence supported by the immediately following single-name selloffs (s11) already live in the source.

sentences.span: Insurify said it blocked Meta's Muse agent, and insurers outperformed the rest of Financials today
sentences.why: All figures and attributions match: SHOP -7% on Meta Pay for Muse concern, EXPE/CART hit despite partnership announcements, insurers that blocked Muse outperformed.

sentences.span: GS TMT SPEC SALES – Thursday 24th September ... it did unveil new VR glasses and the Muse Charm, a palm-sized AI-assistant device
sentences.why: Dated Thursday Sept 24, this note frames the widened hardware lineup (VR glasses, Muse Charm) as current Thursday content, consistent with the sentence's dating.

sentences.span: We maintain our preference for MegaCaps / Large-Caps, though would exercise caution on being short RTY into the Fed print
sentences.why: JPM explicitly names the Fed print as the risk to its short-RTY (small-cap) leg.

No source document in the set references any forecast sized to 'underwrite' a trade tied to today's meeting. The Trump-Xi meeting's occurrence 'today' is corroborated elsewhere (17540), but the specific forecast/trade claim has no traceable source.

sentences.span: Xi Jinping is at a high-stakes US summit with Trump, where their trade truce has been extended… until 10 January
sentences.why: The trade-truce extension, the January 10 tariff hold, and the Trump-Xi meeting occurring today are all confirmed (17530, 17539, 17540). But no document in the given set contains an '$FXI summit trade' or any reference to it being flagged on Tuesday — that specific, load-bearing claim is untraceable in this source set.
